events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher was born on this day in 1972.

angles.name: Liam's Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today. What's your favourite tune from the iconic frontman?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' (1975 UK Re-release)
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was re-released in the UK in 1975, four years after its original debut.

angles.name: Imagine Legacy
angles.copy: Forty-seven years since its UK re-release, John Lennon's 'Imagine' remains a powerful anthem for peace. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: Apple launched the first iPod
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music players.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? Twenty-five years ago, Apple changed how we listened to music forever. What was the first song you downloaded to yours?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the premiere of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No', in London on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: It's Global James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, what's your favourite 007 moment? Shaken, not stirred, of course.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary Beatles co-founder, singer, and songwriter John Lennon was born on this day in 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born on this day in 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Cleese
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! What's your favourite moment from the comedy legend?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' (1968)
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: It's nearly 58 years since The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece, but which track is your go-to?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen, passed away on this day in 1991 at the age of 45.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' (1965)
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965, marking a significant artistic shift.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Vibe
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago today, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. An album that truly changed the game. What's your top track?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: John Lennon, the iconic musician and peace activist, was tragically killed on this day in 1980 at the age of 40.

angles.name: Lennon's Passing
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace live on. What's his most impactful song for you?
